decisions.reason: Because the black-finish range is close to the firm's established offer and its in-house R&D provides related knowledge, management can interpret early results and learn to improve it, so it is unlikely to be dropped.
Because the shower channel is close to the firm's established offer and related drainage know-how supports learning from early results, the firm is likely to keep and improve it.
Because the pump-assisted shower drainage solution builds on the firm's established offer and its own R&D extends related knowledge, management can assimilate feedback and apply improvements.
Because the tileable floor drain is close to the firm's established offer and supported by existing technical knowledge, the firm can interpret early results and is unlikely to drop it.
Because the stainless steel design drain grate is close to the firm's established offer and benefits from related manufacturing and design knowledge, management is likely to keep it.
